text: 謝謝大家 請留待第四集Hello boys and girlsThis is Kathy, it's Tom for English.What's the sound of SH?Yes, SH, shh.Now follow Kathy to read more words with the sound shh.Let's go.showshutshakeshoutshapesharedishrushfreshNow let's read the sentences.I can see six toy ships in the toy shop.My short shots are two shots.She has some fish in the dish.Now watch me, I can read the sentence in this way.Now it's your turn, have a try.Ok, in last period, we read a story, what's the name of the story?Yes, On the Moon.Who's On the Moon?Good, Supergirl and Superdog are On the Moon.Superdog is hungry, what do they do?Yes, they go to the supermarket and get some food.What do they see in the supermarket?Right, they see some moon bread and some moon pies.How does the moon bread feel?Good, it's too hard.And what about the moon pie?Yes, it's soft, nice and yummy.Now read the story by yourself.Let's start.Thanks for your nice reading.Now time for doing exercises.Please open your workbook and turn to page 8, part C, listen, judge and write.First of all, let's read all the words on each box.Box 1, rough, smooth.Box 2, rough, smooth, hard.Box 3, rough, smooth, hard, soft.Now get your pencil, let's listen, judge and write.Page 8, C, listen, judge and write.Open the box please, touch it, how does it feel?It's smooth.Listen, what can you hear?I can hear a watch.2Open the box please, touch it, is it rough?Yes, it is.It is big and hard too.What is it?It's a pineapple.It's soft and smooth.I can hear a cat.OK, let's check.What's in box 1?Yes, watch.How to spell the word watch?Right, w-a-t-c-h watch.It's a watch.How does the watch feel?Good.It isn't rough.And what about box 2?What's in it?Yes, a pineapple.Let's read and spell the word together.Pineapple.How does the pineapple feel?It's rough and hard.It isn't smooth.And in box 3, it's a cat.How does the cat feel?The cat is smooth and soft.It isn't rough or hard.Now, please turn to page 9, part E, look, read and tick.Let's read the dialogue first.I am mom.Can you be hungry?OK, let's start.Open this bag, Henry.Is the banana soft?Is the cake hard?Open this, please.Touch it.How does it feel?Now, please read the dialogue again and tick the right box.Start, please.It's smooth and hard.The cat is smooth and hard.How does the banana feel?Yes, it's soft.How does the cake feel?It's soft and cold.What about the apple pie?It's warm.And what about the toy cat?Yes, it's soft and smooth.We can touch and feel with our hands and fingers.Look around you.Find something.And talk about it.You can write your words on workbook, page 11.Task, part B.Write and say.Now let me share my writing with you.It is a windbell.It's colorful.It's small.It's hard and smooth.I like it.I hope you can share your writing with your family after class.Now let's enjoy a lovely song.What are you doing?And, and, and, I can touch the bubblesWhat can you see?Yes, we can see a teddy bear.You can just call it teddy, teddy.Wow, the bubbles, bubbles, bubbles.Yes, we can see the teddy and hear the bubbles.We also can touch them.Do you like the lovely song?Now follow Cassie to read the lyrics.I can touch the bubbles.When I use my hands, hands, hands.Now let's sing it together.I can touch my teddy.I like your voice so much, thank you.In this unit, we have talked a lot about touching and feeling.Let's end our class with a little rhyme, the sense of touch.Let's read together.The sense of touch.We use our hands and fingers to touch and feel.We can feel something smooth.We can feel something hard.We can feel something rough.We can feel something soft.We are happy to have the sense of touch.After classOne, finish your writing on workbook page 11.Two, sing a song.I hope you can sing the song with your family.Okay, so much for today.Class is over.Bye-bye.
